frames.label: Oct 2023
frames.note: The story begins with the Hamas-led attack of 7 October 2023. The war reads as a response to that day. This is the frame most Israeli official statements open with.

frames.label: 2007 blockade
frames.note: The story begins with Hamas taking Gaza and the closure that followed. The war reads as the end-state of a sixteen-year blockade dynamic. Common in humanitarian-agency timelines.

The story begins with the 1948 war - independence in the Israeli record, the Nakba in the Palestinian one. The war reads as one episode in an unresolved displacement. This is the frame most Palestinian narratives open with.

frames.label: 1917 Balfour
frames.note: The story begins with the Balfour Declaration and the Mandate - a great-power promise about land it did not yet govern. The conflict reads as a colonial-era inheritance. Common in academic historiography and Global South diplomacy.

frames.label: Antiquity
frames.note: The story begins millennia back - two peoples with ancestral attachments to the same land. Every later event reads as a chapter, not a cause. Invoked on all sides when the argument turns to legitimacy.
